# logfire_gateway_project_spending_limits (Resource)

Manages the AI Gateway spending limits of one project. When the project goes over a limit, the Gateway blocks every credential in the project until the window resets. Requires Growth, Enterprise Cloud, or self-hosted and a token with organization:read_gateway and organization:write_gateway scopes (organization:read and organization:write are also accepted). The resource manages all three windows. Destroying it removes every limit of the project. Import accepts the project UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cap the Gateway spend of one project. A window you omit has no limit.
resource "logfire_gateway_project_spending_limits" "example" {
  project_id  = logfire_project.example.id
  weekly_usd  = 200
  monthly_usd = 1000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The UUID of the project that the limits apply to. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `daily_usd` (Number) The daily limit in whole US dollars. A day starts at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no daily limit.
- `monthly_usd` (Number) The monthly limit in whole US dollars. A month starts on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no monthly limit.
- `weekly_usd` (Number) The weekly limit in whole US dollars. A week starts on Monday at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no weekly limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the spending limits of a project by the project UUID.
terraform import 'logfire_gateway_project_spending_limits.example' "018f45c0-3cab-7b2f-a8f7-8a0b55a7ed00"
```
